articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single model, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science questions and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several specialized fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Models Enable Zero-Shot Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: DeepMind demonstrated an updated Gemini Robotics foundation model that allows humanoid and multi-fingered robot hands to perform complex manipulation tasks—such as folding laundry and assembling electronic components—with zero-shot transfer from simulation. The system leverages a vision-language-action architecture that maps natural language instructions directly to fine motor control policies.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Comprehensive Interpretability Map of Claude's Neural Circuitry
articles.summary: Anthropic released a landmark paper detailing mechanistic interpretability breakthroughs that map high-level concepts and reasoning pathways inside large language models at an unprecedented scale. The research identifies specific circuits responsible for chain-of-thought faithfulness, sycophancy, and hallucination, offering concrete levers for targeted safety interventions.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Begins Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen-3 humanoid robot has started supervised operation in select third-party logistics warehouses, handling palletizing and inventory scanning tasks. The rollout marks the first commercial deployment of Optimus outside Tesla's own factories, with the company reporting a target unit cost below $25,000 at scale.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, promising a 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over its N2 node. Early customers include Apple and NVIDIA, with the node expected to power next-generation AI accelerators shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth Open-Weight Model with 2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full open-weight version of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that rivals proprietary frontier systems on reasoning and code generation benchmarks. The release includes quantized variants optimized for single-node inference on 8×H200 setups, dramatically lowering the barrier for enterprises to deploy frontier-class AI privately.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Autonomous Construction Site System
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, in collaboration with Hyundai Engineering, demonstrated a fully integrated autonomous construction workflow using Atlas humanoid robots and Spot quadrupeds coordinating via a centralized planning AI. The system autonomously completed structural inspection, material transport, and welding tasks on a live construction site in Seoul with minimal human oversight.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Hits 1,000-Cycle Milestone in EV Tests
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its lithium-metal solid-state cells achieved over 1,000 fast-charge cycles while retaining greater than 90% capacity in real-world EV pack testing with a major automaker partner. The milestone addresses the key durability concern that has kept solid-state batteries from commercialization and could enable EVs with 500+ mile range and 15-minute charging by 2028.
